items.zh: 不过矛盾还是明显存在。
items.en: Yet contradictions remain in clear view.

items.zh: 他并不隶属于任何大学。
items.en: He is a scholar affiliated with no university.

items.zh: 当然，对往事的怀念也是原因之一。
items.en: And of course, nostalgia plays its part.

items.zh: 这座跨海大桥在落日的映衬下多么壮丽啊！
items.en: How magnificent the cross-sea bridge looks against the backdrop of the sunset!

items.zh: 在失重的环境中，吃饭喝水皆非易事，但中国人对吃的挚爱让我们的宇航员在空间站里成功地吃上了烧烤盛宴。
items.en: Eating and drinking are no easy tasks in the zero-gravity environment, but Chinese people’s love for food is so strong that it drives our astronauts to pull off a barbecue feast on the space station.
